## func [CheckIfConfigIsLegal](<https://github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/server/blob/master/setup/config.go#L31>)

```go
func CheckIfConfigIsLegal(conf *Configuration) error
```

CheckIfConfigIsLegal will check that the configurated values are legal Attention this function uses reflection in a recursive loop and will panic if any struct inside of configuration do not implement the CheckConfig interface\.

## type [CheckConfig](<https://github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/server/blob/master/setup/configparser.go#L12-L15>)

Is used to force this implementation\, by using the internal values inside of checkifConfigIsLegal

```go
type CheckConfig interface {

    CheckConfiguration() error
}
```

## type [Configuration](<https://github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/server/blob/master/setup/config.go#L21-L25>)

Represents a collection of configuration\, that is read out of the configuration file\. As per definition if there is a config file in here It must implement the CheckConfig interface\.

```go
type Configuration struct {
    MapConfig room.MapConfig      `toml:"Map"`
    Web       webconfig.WebConfig `toml:"Webconfig"`
    Logger    LoggerConfig        `toml:"Logging"`
}
```
